steps.clueRiddle:
Go where the fridge hums and the toaster pops.
A mystery is waiting on the counter.
steps.clueReveal: Race to the kitchen counter. A parent will pick three tiny mystery bites. Close your eyes and taste each one!

challenges.title: Mystery Bite
challenges.instructions: Close your eyes tight — no peeking. A parent hands you three tiny bites. Guess each one, then rate your favourite.
checklist: Bite one — I made my guess
Bite two — I made my guess
Bite three — I made my guess
At least one guess was right!

steps.funFact: Real race chefs taste food with their eyes closed to focus their tongue.

steps.clueRiddle:
Some things in this room hide in plain sight.
Count them all and count them right.
steps.clueReveal: Stay in the kitchen for a counting mission. Count every spoon in the drawer. Then count everything stuck to the fridge.

challenges.title: Spoon Census
challenges.instructions: Open the cutlery drawer. Count every single spoon — big and small. Type your number in the box.

challenges.title: Fridge Door Count
challenges.instructions: Look at the outside of the fridge. Count every magnet, photo and note. Nothing on the door escapes you.

steps.funFact: Census is a fancy word for counting everything. Canada does one too.

steps.clueRiddle:
Who can set the table like a fancy hotel?
Plates and forks, and do it well!
steps.clueReveal: Who's ready to be a waiter? Set the table for your whole family. Beat three minutes on the stopwatch.

challenges.title: Table Setting Sprint
challenges.instructions: Start the stopwatch, then set the table. Every person needs a plate, a fork and a cup. Straighten everything before you stop the clock!

steps.funFact: In fancy restaurants the fork always goes on the left.

steps.clueRiddle:
Even home racers need a pit lane.
Park on the couch and power up your brain.
steps.clueReveal: Take a couch break — you earned it. Play the Kitchen Trivia deck. Then race to the kitchen table mat!

challenges.title: Kitchen Trivia Deck
challenges.instructions: Ten tasty questions about food and kitchens. One big question at a time. Streaks light a little fire!

steps.funFact: On the real show, teams quiz each other during every drive.

steps.clueRiddle:
The first mat of the season is set for dinner.
Run to the table — are you the winner?
steps.clueReveal: Race to the kitchen table. Step on the mat. The host is waiting with the standings!
steps.funFact: Pit stop mats are where every leg's drama happens.
